name: Crawler walk
sequence: six alternating-tripod gait phases: left tripod planted/right lift, push, passing, opposite tripod planted/left lift, push, passing; identical shell and no root translation
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation sprite atlas for PHIELDWORKS. Reference image establishes creature identity ONLY, discard its background. Exactly 6 columns x 4 rows. Columns are chronological frames. Rows are four true quarter-turn world directions: head towards bottom-left, bottom-right, top-right, top-left. In last two rows see rear shell, eyes hidden, do not duplicate front views. Crawler walk: six alternating-tripod gait phases: left tripod planted/right lift, push, passing, opposite tripod planted/left lift, push, passing; identical shell and no root translation. Six-legged mineral-plated beetle-like crawler, dark basalt and ochre armor, small copper joints and two subtle cyan eyes, maintain anatomy. Fixed orthographic oblique game camera and upper-left light. Keep same shell silhouette, scale, root anchor and facing within each row, animate limbs only except death body lowering. Genuine transparent RGBA background with zero-alpha empty space, opaque creature. No ground shadow, matte, haze, checkerboard, frame lines, labels or text. 15% empty gutter inside every cell; never touch sheet edges.
